high_level_description: This image captures a dramatic and striking scene of a lighthouse situated on a rocky outcrop in the middle of the ocean. The lighthouse is perched atop a tall, dark rock formation that rises sharply from the water, creating a stark contrast against the surrounding blue sea. A helicopter is parked on the top of the rock, suggesting that it might have been used to transport supplies or personnel to the lighthouse. The setting appears to be remote and isolated, emphasizing the lighthouse's location as one of the most remote in the world, as suggested by the caption.
